description: Draw on the player's screen only, for a while: a build preview (wire boxes or ghosts of the structures), or highlights through walls. Nothing in the world changes.

options.prefab: Prefab: a whole name, a hash, or parts with * ('*Battery*', '*Tank*Insulated*': each part, any order); or a list of them.
options.targets: Up to 64, each one of {id (one or a list), network, at} with color, label, pulse.
options.style: boxes (default), ghost (the structures' own meshes, see-through) or both.
options.run: A cable, pipe or chute run to plan and draw: build's options with what.
options.from_plan: A plan route or spot ref ('r9'): preview its build_arguments.

preview.summary: a planned structure layout or cable, pipe or chute run (build's dry run) as wire boxes or see-through ghosts, plus cells and boxes

placements.description: As build structure's placements; each may give its own tint, and its label shows as the ghost's tooltip.

at.description: A point, "looking_at", or a relative or look-face form (help positions).

facing.description: Where the front points (as build structure).

up.description: Where the top points (as build structure).

face.description: Face-placed pieces: the cell face it sits on.

orient.description: {mount, upright, controls_toward, ports: [{role, index, type, toward}], flow: {from, to}}: choose the turn by intent. mount: wall, floor, ceiling or an axis; a target (controls_toward, toward, from, to): an axis, room, player, a point or a thing's id.

above_floor.description: Bottom this many metres above the floor below at.

build_state.description: finished (default), first, or a state index.

label.description: What the placement is, shown as a tooltip when the crosshair is on its ghost (as build structure's label).

run.description: A cable, pipe or chute run to plan and draw: build cable, pipe or chute's options with what ({what: "pipe", grade, waypoints, ...}); nothing is built.

from_plan.description: A ref of a plan route or plan spot reply ("r9"; one spot: "r9.spots.2", default the first): preview its build_arguments; a route becomes run, a spot the placement, and options given here replace the plan's.
from_plan.x-script: A plan route or plan spot reply (p = sg.plan('route', ...)), or one spot (p['spots'][2]): preview its build_arguments.

style.description: boxes: footprint, body and port wire boxes; ghost: the structures' own meshes at the build state, see-through and tinted; both.

tint.description: The ghosts' colour, yours to choose (no meaning of its own): a palette name (show highlight's), [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] each 0 to 1; alpha 0.4 when left out.

cells.description: Yellow 0.5 m cubes at these points.

boxes.description: {min, max, color} boxes; color: red, green, white, cyan, yellow, any tint name, or [r, g, b] / [r, g, b, a].

xray.description: Draw everything through walls, frames and terrain: boxes and cells whole, ghosts fainter where hidden. A run's ghosts always get the see-through pass (pieces sit inside floors and frames).

verbose.description: plan: build structure's whole report of each placement (orient alternatives, port checks, layout, cost) in place of the brief one.

keys.plan: {ready: bool, problems: list[{code: str, message: str, index: int | None, reference_id: str | None}], warnings: list[{code: str, message: str, index: int | None, reference_id: str | None}], placements: list[{index: int, prefab_name: str | None, position: Vec3 | None, orientation: {facing: str | None, up: str | None, euler: Vec3} | None, build_state: int | None}]} | None
keys.run: {what: str, ready: bool, pieces: int, problems: list[{code: str, message: str}], warnings: list[{code: str, message: str}]} | None

text: Materials are not checked: ready means build would place it. A new call replaces what the last drew (keep: true adds); ghosts counts this call's ghosts, ghosts_total every preview ghost on screen.

highlight.summary: show the player where things, a network or far points are, tinted and labelled

targets.description: Up to 64, each one of {id (one or a list), network, at} with color, label, pulse.

keys.targets: list[{index: int, kind: str, color: str, label: str | None, pulse: bool, network_id: str | None, things: int | None, missing: list[str] | None, truncated: bool | None, at: Vec3 | None, distance_m: float | None, bearing_deg: float | None, compass: str | None, rise_m: float | None}]

ghost.summary: put planned structures on the world's ghost board, where every player sees them until they are built or taken off; or take ghosts off

placements.description: As build structure's placements; each may give its own tint and label.

at.description: A point, "looking_at", or a relative or look-face form (help positions).

facing.description: Where the front points (as build structure).

up.description: Where the top points (as build structure).

face.description: Face-placed pieces: the cell face it sits on.

orient.description: {mount, upright, controls_toward, ports: [{role, index, type, toward}], flow: {from, to}}: choose the turn by intent. mount: wall, floor, ceiling or an axis; a target (controls_toward, toward, from, to): an axis, room, player, a point or a thing's id.

above_floor.description: Bottom this many metres above the floor below at.

build_state.description: finished (default), first, or a state index.

from_plan.description: A plan spot ref ("r9"; one spot: "r9.spots.2", default the first): put its placement on the board.
from_plan.x-script: A plan spot reply (p = sg.plan('spot', ...)) or one spot (p['spots'][2]): put it on the board.

tint.description: The ghosts' colour, yours to choose: a name (cyan, magenta, yellow, green, orange, blue, red, white, purple, pink, khaki, brown, black, gray), [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] each 0 to 1.

label.description: What the ghosts are, shown as a tooltip when the crosshair is on one, and in find ghost; a placement's own label wins.

remove.description: Ghost ids to take off the board (find ghost lists them).

clear.description: Take off every ghost agents placed, or every ghost.

text: A ghost lasts until it is taken off or a structure of its prefab is built where it stands, kept with the save; players see it, move around it, take it off (RemoveGhostKey) and place their own (ghost mode, the ghost menu). The placements are planned as build structure plans them (nothing built, materials not checked) and each goes on the board where the plan put it, problems or not; the reply's plan says why one would not build. find ghost lists the board.

keys.placed: list[{id: int, prefab_name: str, position: Vec3}]
keys.plan: {ready: bool, problems: list[{code: str, message: str, index: int | None, reference_id: str | None}], warnings: list[{code: str, message: str, index: int | None, reference_id: str | None}]} | None
